thread:
Maya (PM): Quick proposal — introduce a small "Burst Credits" add-on and tighten free-tier caps to limit abuse. Goal: give PLG users a cheap short-term scale-up option while keeping reserved contracts predictable. Need launch criteria, contract constraints, and engineering scope. Ping @Daniel, @Lena, @Arjun, @Sam for input.

Daniel (Finance): Rough back-of-envelope: price burst at $0.002/token (example). If average purchase = 50k tokens -> $100 revenue each. With 5% attach rate on active free users, projected +6–9% ARR on our cohort. Main risk: cannibalization of Reserved credits.

Lena (Sales): We see requests for predictable overage caps rather than variable overage charges. Customers prefer: a) soft cap (notify + auto-elevate to reserved pricing) or b) fixed burst pack they can pre-buy. Sales want per-account negotiation for deals > $50k ARR. Also need clear playbook for upsell messaging.

Arjun (Eng): Implementation notes: enforcement + billing hook + telemetry + UI for purchase flows. Estimate: 3 sprints to build server-side enforcement + billing integration + admin UI; add 1 sprint for docs/QA. Prefer rolling feature-flagged beta to 10% of free users first. We can reuse /quota service but need new events. Example config draft:

```
{
  "tier": "burst",
  "tokens": 50000,
  "price_usd": 100,
  "expiry_days": 30,
  "overage_policy": "block|fallback|charge",
  "billing_code": "burst_pack_v1"
}
```

Arjun (Eng): Also need schema for telemetry: `burst.purchase`, `burst.usage`, `burst.expiry`, `burst.converted_to_reserved`. Those will feed Optimize for unit economics.

Sam (Legal): Contract/legal constraints: must include explicit opt-in for auto-renewing burst packs in contracts and UX, and a clear refund/cancellation policy for partial usage. For Private customers, ensure burst purchases are allowed only if data residency & KMS policies satisfied — otherwise block. Also add clause for reserved capacity conversion timing (e.g., 72h notice).

Maya (PM): Launch criteria proposal (must be met for GA):
- Billing integration completed and e2e verified
- Product + pricing page copy + docs published
- Legal signoff on T&Cs and opt-in language
- Sales playbook + negotiation guardrails (discount cap, escalation path)
- Telemetry pipeline and dashboard (attach rate, churn by cohort)
- Beta run 4 weeks with SLOs met (latency + usage charge correctness)

Daniel (Finance): One more ask — set a minimum unit-econ threshold before GA. Example: contribution margin >= 40% after infra + billing costs. If burst drives <40% margin, restrict to beta/partner-only.

Lena (Sales): Agreed on partner-only if low margin. Also request a 'soft-negotiation' clause: allow discounts up to 25% on burst packs for strategic logos with approval from finance.

Arjun (Eng): For rollout: feature-flag controls for (a) enable/disable purchase, (b) cap per-account, (c) emergency kill-switch. ETA to first beta: 6 weeks if prioritized. Need one backend engineer + 0.5 frontend + QA.

Maya (PM): OK — next steps: Daniel to provide target price bands + margin thresholds by EOD Wed. Lena to draft sales playbook bullets. Arjun to scope tickets and PR estimates. Sam to draft contract language examples. I will create tasks and schedule product review.

pm-bot: Created task PLAT-3324: "Burst credits add-on — beta implementation" assigned to @Arjun, @Maya. Link: https://org.kanban/PLAT-3324

Lena (Sales): :thumbsup:

Daniel (Finance): Quick Q — should burst be refundable within 24h? Refunds affect margin calculations.

Sam (Legal): Refund policy: recommend non-refundable after 24h; allow 24h window for accidental purchases. Add dispute process.

Arjun (Eng): Noted — will add `purchase_timestamp` and refund flag to events.

Maya (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate into the PRD and circulate beta launch checklist tomorrow.
